durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.title: Durability Indicator Settings
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.enabl: Show durability numbers on damageable items.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.showU: Show durability numbers on undamaged items while in Creative Mode.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.textS: Adjust the size of durability numbers.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.compa: Display 1561 as 1,6k instead of the exact value.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.textS: Render a shadow behind durability numbers.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.showV: Show the original Minecraft durability bar below the durability number.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.xOffs: Move the durability number left or right.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.yOffs: Adjust the vertical position when the vanilla durability bar is visible.
Adjust the vertical position when the vanilla durability bar is hidden.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.green: Minimum durability percentage for green. Keep thresholds in descending order.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.orang: Minimum durability percentage for orange. Keep thresholds in descending order.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.yello: Minimum durability percentage for yellow. Keep thresholds in descending order.
durabilityindicator.midnightconfig.redTh: Minimum durability percentage for red. Lower values use dark red.
